messages:
Elena Park: Quick check for Polaris dry-run tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final signoffs on: egress to splunk.polaris.internal, runtime IAM least-priv for KMS envelope flow, KMS grant vs policy, and audit log retention (they requested 180d). Any blockers?
Ravi Menon: Firewall ticket POL-462 still in review. Staging approved but prod-preview needs infra signoff.
Keiko Sato: Runtime role missing kms:GenerateDataKey and kms:Decrypt for alias/polaris-enc. Draft PR ready, tagging security for scoping.
Jamal Ortiz: Polaris prefers a KMS Grant with EncryptionContext constraint rather than broad key policy. Need monitor role ARN from them to create grant.
OnboardBot: dry-run-report-3521200000: failures: audit-forwarder (connect timeout), key-access (AccessDenied). run id: a1c2d3.
Elena Park: That matches. Ravi please escalate POL-462 so prod-preview rule is applied before 18:00 PT. Keiko merge PR once security OK. Jamal prepare grant template and post here.
Ravi Menon: Escalated and assigned to infra-eng@polaris. Will update when ACL (10.12.7.90:443) is in prod-preview.
Keiko Sato: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/polaris-onboard/pull/22 . Snippet added to runbook: 
```
# IAM snippet
Effect: Allow
Action: ["kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:Decrypt"]
Resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:888888:key/alias/polaris-enc
```
Jamal Ortiz: Grant template posted: 
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/polaris-enc --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/polaris-monitor --operations Encrypt Decrypt GenerateDataKey --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"purpose":"audit"}
```
Ravi Menon: Prod-preview rule applied. ACL id acl-p-7782. Connectivity test to 10.12.7.90:443 succeeded from priv-subnet-a. :white_check_mark:
Keiko Sato: Security approved PR scoping and merged. Added verification steps to runbook: 
```bash
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://cipher.bin --key-id alias/polaris-enc
aws logs tail /aws/audit --filter-pattern "polaris" --start 1h
```
Jamal Ortiz: Polaris provided monitor role ARN. Grant created g-0a1b2c. Asked Polaris to verify decrypt of sample envelope.
Elena Park: I'll run the focused dry-run at 09:05 PT. Please add a troubleshooting table to the runbook with exact error strings (e.g., ConnectTimeout, kms:AccessDenied) so operations can triage quickly.
Keiko Sato: Adding troubleshooting table and retention note (180d + billing impact) now.
Elena Park: Thanks all 44d If dry-run green we'll schedule enablement and mark onboarding tasks complete.
